title: Phase ladder, v1
description: The record at <root>/gates/ladder.json, produced by nousergon_lib.gates.build_ladder/ladder_payload and published by exactly ONE writer per adopter. A second publisher that re-evaluates every gate under its own environment will republish a false reading over the gate publisher's (crucible, alpha-engine-config-I10575); adopters publish from the gate command only. Versioned because a fleet console reads this key through an s3-records adapter, a cross-repo consumer; additionalProperties: false because a field this reader does not understand is a field the producer expected it to act on. Generalized from crucible/schemas/phase_ladder.v1.json on the second adoption: `phase` and `number` are no longer bounded to crucible's phase0..phase5, and `tracker`/`decision_id` accept any <repo>-I<N> ref, so a second ladder with its own rungs and its own tracker validates under the same contract.

schema_version.title: Schema Version
schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema. A consumer that cannot read the version refuses the document rather than guessing.

ladder.title: Ladder
ladder.description: Which ladder this is, when one store holds more than one (e.g. `crucible` and `data`). Optional so crucible's existing document validates unchanged.

trading_day.title: Trading Day
trading_day.description: The NYSE trading day the ladder was built for. Never a wall-clock date.

current_phase.title: Current Phase
current_phase.description: The lowest phase whose gate is not met, or `complete`. Not the highest phase with work in it.

unmeasured.title: Unmeasured
unmeasured.description: Count of rows whose gate_state is UNMEASURED. Published rather than left for a reader to derive.

out_of_order.title: Out Of Order
out_of_order.description: Phase ids currently graded ahead of an earlier unmet phase.

PhaseLadderRow.title: PhaseLadderRow
PhaseLadderRow.description: One phase row of the ladder's `phases` array.

decision_id.title: Decision Id
decision_id.description: `console-policy` §2.1: the identifier IS the tracker ref, so a `git-host` claim about the same issue merges onto this row rather than rendering the phase twice.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: The registered gate name, or null when no gate has been written for this phase yet. Null is never a pass: the row renders UNMEASURED.

clauses_met.title: Clauses Met
clauses_met.description: null when the phase has never been graded at all (no registered gate).

clauses_unmeasurable.title: Clauses Unmeasurable
clauses_unmeasurable.description: Count of this phase's clauses that read UNMEASURABLE (a store access failure, distinct from a clause read and found unmet). null exactly where clauses_total is null.

met_ratio.title: Met Ratio
met_ratio.description: null when nothing was measured, or when any clause is unmeasurable. Never 0.0 for an unmeasured reading -- 0.0 is a real measurement of zero clauses met out of a nonzero total (principle 7).

read_on.title: Read On
read_on.description: The last trading day this gate was read, or null when never.

blocked_by.title: Blocked By
blocked_by.description: The earlier unmet phase id blocking this one, when state is OUT_OF_ORDER; null otherwise.
